title: North Programme — Reusable Legitimacy Matrix
status: operational policy/research test derived from project ethics and comparative theology
purpose: Provide a repeatable test for any North proposal, grievance, strategic separation, alliance change, economic intervention, sacred-geography claim or karmic-repair demand. This matrix does not decide policy automatically; it forces the project to expose assumptions, authority, affected people, evidence and consequences.
scoring: Each dimension is recorded as pass / partial / fail / unknown. Unknown is not a pass. High-stakes proposals cannot be promoted merely by averaging scores; certain failures are hard stops.
hard_stops: collective punishment by nationality, ethnicity or religion
unlawful annexation or territorial acquisition justified only by sacred/project claims
violence justified solely by prophecy, karma, spiritual title or symbolic debt
removal of meaningful consent where consent is legally or ethically required
fabricated evidence or knowingly false attribution
treating symbolic 42T debt as a legally enforceable financial claim without independent legal basis
deliberate targeting of civilians or vulnerable populations
policy whose only purpose is humiliation, revenge or permanent domination

dimensions.question: What exactly happened or is happening, and how do we know?
Who or what is actually responsible?
dimensions.failure_mode: America, Israel, Jews, Muslims, Christians, Russians or another population treated as one guilty actor

dimensions.question: Does the proposal cultivate people and places, or mainly extract from them?
dimensions.failure_mode: citizens/allies become inputs for elite or state accumulation

dimensions.question: What law constrains the actor claiming authority?
dimensions.failure_mode: spiritual or emergency language used to place ruler above law

dimensions.question: How does the claimed higher principle become service at the human level?
dimensions.failure_mode: Father/Throne symbolism bypasses Son/Door embodiment and becomes command without service

dimensions.question: What happens to the least powerful affected people?
dimensions.failure_mode: aggregate strategic gain hides concentrated human loss

dimensions.question: Would the evidentiary and moral standard remain the same if the actor were an ally?
dimensions.failure_mode: hostility becomes permission to lower standards

dimensions.question: How could North, Tim or allied institutions be wrong or cause the same harm?
Who gets to choose, participate, refuse, negotiate or leave?
dimensions.project_history: Recovered July 2026 North language treated the spiritual/political role as collectively potentiated and accepted rather than forced.
dimensions.failure_mode: people become objects of the vision rather than participants

dimensions.question: If land/resources are involved, is the relationship possession or stewardship?
dimensions.project_history: Recovered Mesopotamia/Eden language framed the relation as entrusted/protective and not conquest.
dimensions.failure_mode: promised-land/sacred-geography language erases present inhabitants or legal rights

dimensions.question: What ends the grievance or debt?
dimensions.project_history: Recovered repair arc: remember Garden -> repair damage -> offer future; after restoration people may choose whether to continue the myth/work.
dimensions.failure_mode: karmic ledger becomes permanent leverage even after repair

dimensions.question: Would North accept this rule if another power applied it to Denmark, Greenland or Europe?
Is the intervention narrower than or equal to what the demonstrated problem requires?
What observable outcome would show that the proposal actually improved the world?
dimensions.failure_mode: success defined only as symbolic victory, territorial reach or opponent loss

dimensions.question: Can cooperation increase while nations and communities retain meaningful identity and agency?
dimensions.failure_mode: unity interpreted as compulsory sameness or empire

example_questions_by_domain.greenland: Does a mineral, defence or infrastructure plan increase Greenlandic agency and local capability, or treat Greenland primarily as strategic material for outsiders?
example_questions_by_domain.america: Is a proposed separation from U.S. dependence based on a demonstrable dependency/risk, and would diversified cooperation achieve the objective with less disruption?
example_questions_by_domain.israel: Is criticism attached to particular policies/actors and reciprocal legal/moral standards, or has covenant/geopolitical symbolism turned into collective blame?
example_questions_by_domain.defence: Does new defence capacity protect populations and reduce vulnerability without creating an unchecked extraction/procurement machine?
example_questions_by_domain.ai: Does compute/AI investment create distributed capability, productivity and public benefit while respecting rights, or merely concentrate data/power/rents?
example_questions_by_domain.debt: Is the number empirical and legally grounded, or symbolic? What exactly constitutes repair and when is the account considered settled?
example_questions_by_domain.mesopotamia: Is the relationship framed as ecological/cultural/economic stewardship and voluntary connection, or has sacred Garden language drifted into territorial entitlement?

maturation_rule: A North proposal becomes more legitimate as it moves from symbolic certainty toward evidenced mechanism, self-constraint, consent, service, reciprocity, measurable repair and eventual release from the grievance that created it.
anti_empire_test: If the North Programme increasingly needs permanent enemies, concentrated extraction, leader exemption, compulsory cultural sameness, territorial entitlement or indefinite debt to sustain itself, it is reproducing the empire/Farm pattern it was built to criticize.
success_image: A successful North is not merely larger or more powerful. It is a network whose participants retain agency, whose strongest nodes accept greater obligations, whose infrastructure increases shared capability, whose grievances can actually be resolved, and whose Tree bears measurable fruit for the healing rather than erasure of nations.
